Hong Kong Bridge Traffic Impacts Local Transport Services

A lawmaker has stated that a record high in vehicle traffic on the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge last year has negatively impacted ferry and helicopter services. Transport Department figures indicate a significant increase in bridge usage. The boom in bridge traffic has led to a decline in patronage for traditional transport options that connect Hong Kong with the mainland.
